## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION — Sector signals mixed with weak breadth: Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Technology strength versus weak broader participation and a Narrow leadership (Top 5 all Technology) confirm the CAUTION call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND; Tech 1W: +6.30% (24 stocks) showing concentrated upside. Consumer Staples and Materials follow: MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (news mover) showing tailwinds.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy, Utilities and Financials lag: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND; sector weakness is broad and confirms limited market participation.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +14.80% | 1M: +24.49%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -6.41% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -3.08%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W vs 1M mismatch — e.g., META RECOVERY, V CORRECTION, SLB CORRECTION) — tactical opportunities not core.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is strong but narrow: AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W positive but leadership concentrated and breadth limited (one of 4 positive sectors).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials pressured: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -2.18% with multiple large names showing deterioration.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed to weak: UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND — select strength in UNH amid uneven sector internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor trimming concentration risk in narrow Tech leaders and reduce exposure to lagging Energy/Financial names; consider favoring names with confirmed multi-timeframe strength (e.g., AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND) while monitoring divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -30.63%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.30%) — watch for leadership breadth expansion.  
BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.04%) and Financials (1W: -2.18%) — monitor for continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch whether NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) maintains its 1M momentum as a confirmation trigger; AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) holding recent gains would support Tech breadth; JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) reclaiming 1W losses would be needed to stabilize Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (+80): Earnings beat and guidance lift; UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
EOG (+60): Beat-driven uplift but EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND — news/price diverging, watch follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-45): Negative coverage on fundamentals; PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
NOW (-60): Significant stake reduction headline is bearish; monitor price action for confirmation (watch for 1W/1M breakdown).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Growth/Momentum bias but narrow leadership concentrated in Technology. AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND holds as a defensive growth pocket. Key risk is narrow, concentrated leadership and cross-market divergences (e.g., META RECOVERY, V CORRECTION, SLB CORRECTION) alongside mixed news confirmations (UNH confirmed, EOG diverging).
